decisions.reason: As an outpatient support service closely related to care and psychiatric assistance and promoted more prominently in 2024, it looks strategically relevant and likely to remain in the portfolio.
Counseling for senior living is strongly aligned with the firm's core residential-care business and its continued home-page placement suggests it is an important offering and referral channel.

The sheltered-workshop retail shop is somewhat less core than care services but its higher visibility in 2024 indicates acceptable traction and mission fit, so it is more likely to be continued than withdrawn.
Meal delivery for seniors fits the aging and care market well, but as a newer and less prominently presented offer it carries a higher review risk even though it is still worth keeping for now.
